numeric_column_size.note: TanStack auto-detects numeric columns and sorts DESCENDING on first click (sortDescFirst auto). Observed and expected library behaviour, not a defect.

conclusion: All allowed columns expose asc/desc/clear via the header button (aria-label 'X: 升序/降序/清除排序' and aria-sort on th); verified on one string column and one numeric column.
harness_note: agent-browser click on the header button returned a false 'covered by h1' guard error while document.elementFromPoint returned the button itself; clicks were then issued as real mouse move/down/up at the button centre. Harness guard false-positive, not a product issue.
